name: get_deployment_file_contents
description:
Get the contents of a file from a deployment's source by deployment ID and file ID. Returns the contents base64-encoded. For Git deployments, path identifies the file.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v8/deployments/{id}/files/{fileId} --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

path.description: Path to the file to fetch (only for Git deployments)

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
